manualClock.label: measured
manualClock.note: node:test drives the injected clock. 150 = 2400/16. This is the driver, not a browser frame rate.

browserReplay.label: measured
browserReplay.note: MutationObserver on data-t during one Replay click. Two samples from the same Playwright run family. Attribute updates can be fewer than animation frames when quantize does not change the displayed value.

proposedBudget.label: proposed
proposedBudget.note: Not a CI performance gate. Playwright only fails this sample if replay never finishes or runs longer than 8s (stuck-loop guard).
